description: Estaciones de la red de control de aforo de la demarcación hidrográfica del Guadalquivir is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Identificación y delimitación de la red de estaciones de aforos existentes en el ámbito de la demarcación hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Coverage: Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. The publisher named on the listing is Confederación Hidrográfica del Guadalquivir. Its keywords include redes de control. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML%2BXML, JPEG, GEO%2BJSON, X-ZIPPED-SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://idechg.chguadalquivir.es/geochg/legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
